answer: Audits are written down in shale, queued in jetty, and kernel publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 93 identities per epoch. A farm of 30 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4433 identities would post 3350 proofs and burn roughly 24 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
